## Summary / 概述

Link the submission issue and describe this change.
关联投稿 Issue，说明本次改动。

## Materials / 投稿材料

For theme submissions, include the source commit, theme directory, preview, author credits, and applicable license. Describe changed states for updates. Mark sections that do not apply to documentation or tooling changes.
主题投稿请提供源提交、主题目录、预览、作者署名和实际许可；更新请说明变更的状态。文档或工具改动可标记不适用。

## Validation / 验证

List the checks actually run and their results. For artwork, include the tested Clawd version, operating system, visual evidence, and anything untested.
列出实际检查及结果。美术投稿补充 Clawd 版本、系统、视觉证据与未测项。

## Publication / 发布

- [ ] Large animation files and ZIPs are outside Git history / 大型动画和 ZIP 未提交到本仓库 Git 历史
- [ ] The documented source and license match this submission / 来源和许可与本次投稿一致
- [ ] This initial submission leaves catalog publication to maintainers, or this is an agreed release PR with public assets and an increased catalogVersion / 初次投稿由维护者后续上架，或本 PR 是已商定的发布改动且附件已公开、catalogVersion 已递增

For documentation-only changes, mark publication checks as not applicable.
纯文档改动可将发布检查标为不适用。
